teams.synopsis: Dethroned Grits after three weeks as runner-up - with Puka injured, Bijan is now top dog in the league.
teams.blurb: After 3 weeks being ranked as the 2nd-best team, Make Fantasy Great Again has dethroned Grits and taken their place atop the league. With Puka now injured, Bijan is top dog. I don't believe the 2nd half of the season will be as successful as the first, but for now, this is the team to beat. Top performer from Week 6: Bijan Robinson (35.8). Current record: 6-0. Projected: 11-3.

teams.synopsis: The most points scored this season, yet only 3-3 - the schedule opens up significantly from Weeks 8-10.
teams.blurb: One of the sneakiest teams all year, STD has the most points scored this season but is only 3-3. With another unlucky matchup in Week 7, this trend may continue. Luckily for them, the schedule then opens up from weeks 8-10, where their opponents have a combined record of 6-12. Top performer from Week 6: Patrick Mahomes (31.5). Current record: 3-3. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: They continue to rise, projected for a league-high 134 points with Lamb and QJ returning from injury.
teams.blurb: They continue to rise, but for now, The Minutemen will have to settle for 3rd. With Lamb and QJ most likely returning from injury in Week 7, this team is projected to score a league-high 134 points. Interestingly enough, their opponent is projected the second-most, with 129 points. Top performer from Week 6: Josh Jacobs (32). Current record: 3-3. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: A solidified top team that keeps climbing - favored to reach 6-1, the best start in franchise history.
teams.blurb: A solidified top team in the league, Monke has done nothing but climb the ranks in recent weeks. The team gets a tough and hungry opponent in Week 7, but as of now, they're favored to advance to 6-1, which would be the best start in franchise history. On to Week 7. Top performer from Week 6: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (30.2). Current record: 5-1. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: All eyes on Garrett Wilson's injury severity - talented enough to compete with most of the league even without him.
teams.blurb: All eyes are on Garrett Wilson's injury severity; if he's sidelined for a few weeks, it may limit LP's success. Still, the team is well-rounded and talented enough to compete with two-thirds of the league even without the star WR. Like Grits, I expect this team to stay steady in the second half. Top performer from Week 6: Jonathan Taylor (23.7). Current record: 4-2. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: A big drop, but it might be justified - the Bowers, Puka, and Egbuka injuries will decide how the next stretch goes.
teams.blurb: Maybe this is too much of a drop, but let's see what happens. The success of this team in the coming weeks will largely depend on the severity of the Bowers, Puka, and Egbuka injuries and how much the supporting cast will step up. I have faith in Grits to stay strong, but it will get dicey. Top performer from Week 6: Cam Skattebo (31). Current record: 5-1. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: Still put up big numbers despite the loss, locking down a top-7 spot - a 5-3 finish feels likely from here.
teams.blurb: Despite the loss in Week 6, RWB was still able to put up big numbers and lock down their place as a top-7 team in the league. Although they're currently 2-4, I think the team will find a lot more success the rest of the way, going 5-3 in the process. It starts with a tough matchup in Week 7. Top performer from Week 6: Rico Dowdle (33.9). Current record: 2-4. Projected: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: Only topped 120 points once despite a fully healthy lineup and no byes - still in solid playoff position.
teams.blurb: I have not been overly impressed with NY so far. The team has only topped 120 points once, despite having a fully healthy lineup and no byes until now. With Cook sitting this week, let's see how they respond. Still, NY remains in a solid position to make the playoffs as a top-8 team. Top performer from Week 6: Ja'Marr Chase (25.1). Current record: 3-3. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: Don't be fooled by the 3-3 record - one of only four teams on a losing streak of 3 or more.
teams.blurb: Don't be fooled, the team is 3-3, but they're one of only four teams to have a losing streak of 3 or more. Still, the team is in a position to potentially make a playoff push and extend their streak to 6 years, but it'll all depend on luck at this point. Team is going on autopilot now. Top performer from Week 6: Trey McBride (21.2). Current record: 3-3. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: No change in rank - the team did what it was supposed to, though the Week 7 matchup won't be easy.
teams.blurb: No change in rank this week; the team did what they were supposed to. Now, in Week 7, they matchup against a tough-ranked team, and I don't love their chances, but who knows. I don't think this is a playoff team in 2025, but the team is safe in my mind from punishment. Top performer from Week 6: George Pickens (31.8). Current record: 2-4. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: A huge Week 6 win, and an even bigger break - an injured Week 7 opponent could set up a real playoff push.
teams.blurb: Earning a win in Week 6 was huge, but having an injured opponent in Week 7 is even bigger. If this team can capitalize on the weak matchup, then we're looking at a potential playoff push. All eyes on Week 7. Top performer from Week 6: De'Von Achane (31). Current record: 2-4. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: A team on the cusp of coming together - byes clearing, BTJ finally producing, and Evans returning from injury.
teams.blurb: I like DENT's chances to rebound in Week 7 after falling to 2-4. The team seems like it's on the cusp of coming together, with some byes out of the way, BTJ finally performing, and Evans returning from injury. Don't be surprised if this team climbs the ranks and into the top 8. Top performer from Week 6: Brian Thomas Jr. (23). Current record: 2-4. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: A potential playoff push in the second half, but there needs to be signs of life first.
teams.blurb: While I do believe this team has the potential to make a playoff push during the 2nd half of the season, until I see some life, I can't put them any higher than this. Rice's return will be a much-needed boost, but will it be enough to help the team avoid punishment? We shall see. Top performer from Week 6: Bo Nix (13.4). Current record: 1-5. Projected: 4-10.

teams.synopsis: No light at the end of the tunnel - the only shot at salvation is beating RPM's backup team in a couple weeks.
teams.blurb: There is no light at the end of the tunnel for this team. TTF's only chance at salvation is beating RPM's backup team when they face off in a couple of weeks. The team's most productive player as of late will return to being a backup when Bucky returns. TTF has 12 D/ST points this season. Twelve. Top performer from Week 6: Jalen Hurts (20.6). Current record: 1-5. Projected: 4-10.
